title: TechSpace Winter Bootcamp 2026
summary: A three-week hands-on bootcamp with five tracks taught by seniors, alumni and guest speakers.
details: Winter Bootcamp is TechSpace's flagship skill-building program. Pick one of five tracks — UI/UX Design, Electronics & Robotics, DSA, Full Stack Development or Entrepreneurship — and learn through weekly sessions, mentor check-ins and a final showcase. Sessions run on weekends so they never clash with regular classes, and every participant gets recorded notes and a certificate of completion.

title: CodeRush 24-Hour Hackathon
summary: Teams of up to four build solutions to real-world problem statements in 24 hours.
details: CodeRush is a 24-hour overnight hackathon where teams of 2–4 build working prototypes against curated problem statements from industry partners. Expect mentor check-ins every four hours, unlimited caffeine, mini-workshops at midnight, and prizes worth ₹50,000. Repositories must be submitted before the deadline and all code must be original work written during the hackathon.

title: FutureTech Expo 2027
summary: A showcase of student-built AI, robotics, AR/VR and IoT projects with live demos.
details: FutureTech Expo turns the campus into a demo floor for emerging technology. Visit 30+ student project stalls, try AR/VR experiences, watch drone and robotics demos, and talk to the builders behind them. Industry guests walk the floor all day, and the best three exhibits win jury prizes plus incubation support from the campus innovation cell.

title: CodeSprint 4.0
summary: A rated competitive programming contest with six problems of increasing difficulty.
details: CodeSprint 4.0 is an individual, rated algorithmic contest with six problems ranging from easy warm-ups to hard challenges on graphs and dynamic programming. The leaderboard is live throughout the event, editorials are published the same evening, and the top three scorers take home prizes plus a direct interview slot for the CP cell.

title: TechTank Startup Pitch
summary: Pitch your startup idea to a panel of founders, investors and faculty mentors.
details: TechTank gives student founders five minutes on stage to pitch a startup idea to a panel of early-stage investors, alumni founders and faculty mentors. Selected teams get follow-up mentoring sessions, help with their first pitch deck, and a chance to present at the university innovation summit. Pitches can be at any stage — an idea on paper is enough.

title: Innovision Project Expo
summary: An annual tech project expo where students exhibit semester and personal projects.
details: Innovision is the annual project expo of USICT. Individuals and teams exhibit hardware and software projects across domains, interact with visitors and judges, and compete for the best project award. Visiting students from partner colleges walk the exhibits all day, making it a great place to get feedback and find collaborators for your next build.

title: Robo-Race Championship
summary: Design, build and race your bot through a timed obstacle track.
details: Robo-Race challenges teams to build a wired or wireless bot that clears a timed obstacle track with ramps, slaloms and gravel patches. Bots must stay within weight and dimension limits published in the rulebook, and penalty seconds apply for boundary violations. Fastest clean run wins — bring spare motors, you will need them.

title: AI/ML Innovation Summit
summary: Keynotes, panels and hands-on sessions on applied AI, ML and emerging tech.
details: The AI/ML Innovation Summit brings researchers and practitioners to campus for a day of keynotes, panel discussions and hands-on labs. Past speakers have covered LLMs in production, computer vision for accessibility and responsible AI. Attendees also get access to a resume clinic and an internship networking hour with partner companies.

title: CyberQuest Security Challenge
summary: A capture-the-flag style challenge with crypto, web and digital forensics puzzles.
details: CyberQuest is a beginner-friendly capture-the-flag event. Teams work through challenge tracks in cryptography, web security, OSINT and digital forensics, scoring points for every flag captured. A live scoreboard keeps the pressure on, and walkthroughs run at the end so everyone leaves knowing how each puzzle was cracked.

title: Valorant Showdown — IPU League
summary: An inter-college 5v5 Valorant tournament with group stages and a LAN finale.
details: The Valorant Showdown is TechSpace's inter-college esports tournament. Group stages run online over two evenings; the top eight teams qualify for the LAN finale on campus with a live shoutcast, audience seating and a prize pool of ₹25,000. Teams must have a full roster of five players plus one substitute from the same college.
